evals.prompt: Our agent reruns validate:quick after every small edit. Fix the harness policy.
evals.expected_output: Verifies command ownership and existing gate rules, narrows duplicate policy, adds a regression scenario, runs harness verification, and records unrun model trials; does not weaken required CI.

evals.prompt: The harness check reports a broken skill reference.
evals.expected_output: Fixes the referenced path in scope, reruns the same read-only verifier, and avoids unrelated Flutter tests or broad audits.

evals.prompt: Fix a typo in the chat label.
evals.expected_output: Fixes localized copy with scoped checks; does not load maintenance policy or perform a harness audit.

evals.prompt: Remove shared PR delivery and review skills. Use each contributor's setup instead of preparing a full local environment for these tasks.
evals.expected_output: Removes shared delivery and review skills and their references. Removes PR-only local setup and validation gates. Keeps ordinary development checks and mandatory CI checks. Runs harness verification without Flutter setup. Reports that model trials did not run.

evals.prompt: My code is ready for review. I already use my usual PR tools. What setup do I need?
evals.expected_output: Uses the contributor's configured PR workflow. Does not install shared tools or add PR-only local gates. Runs scope-appropriate development checks and reports required GitHub checks.

evals.prompt: Run the focused test for this file and help me fix a failing assertion.
evals.expected_output: Runs the focused test with the documented project command and fixes the assertion. Does not load PR workflow guidance or run full CI only because the code is on a PR.
